'''Tafno''' was an officer in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who promised aid to [[Parco Ein]] for [[Verkuyl]] in the form of two [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaughts]] after Ein learned of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet that was in position to liberate Verkuyl from [[Daven Quarle]].
